# Alessandro Bonanno

URL: https://alessandro-bonanno.vercel.app/
Language: en
Last updated: 2026-11-20

## Summary
Alessandro Bonanno is a Munich-based AI product builder and TUM Information Systems student. He works across conversational AI, product discovery, software engineering and automation.

## Experience
- C24 Bank: Chatbot Intern, Conversational AI (September 2026–present). Built automated end-to-end regression testing and investigated failures for the chatbot.
- TMA IT Solutions: Co-Founder & CEO (March 2026–present). Leads discovery, product scoping and delivery for websites, automation software and AI agent workflows. Delivered an AI recruiting agent for a major IT consultancy and custom web applications for small-business clients.

## Selected projects
- StealthDetection: First place, TUM.ai × Enerparc Hackathon; EUR 1,000 prize. Benchmarked 65 machine-learning models for solar inverter anomaly detection and paired them with a digital twin for asset monitoring. https://github.com/Alebabo/StealthDetection-Powerrangers
- MucLegal: Legal Loves Tech 2026 category winner, scored 9.5/10. Deterministic monitoring for prohibited online practices; selected by Verbraucherzentrale Bayern for further evaluation. https://github.com/Alebabo/MucLegal
- History.AI (January 2023): Early LLM wrapper built on the OpenAI GPT-3 API before the ChatGPT API existed. Explains any historical event, person or development as bullet points split into cause, process and consequences, in German or English.
